name: initial-po-routing-classification
description: Classify a PO-related email as portal-only mail or base PO mail.

evaluator_descriptions.portal_accuracy: 1.0 if model correctly predicts is_portal_mail, else 0.0.
evaluator_descriptions.base_accuracy: 1.0 if model correctly predicts is_base_po_mail, else 0.0.
evaluator_descriptions.overall_accuracy: 1.0 only if both boolean flags are correct, else 0.0.
